description: This file contains unit tests for the DeviceModelCatalog component, verifying its symbol generation and presentation logic based on device attributes.

classes.name: DeviceModelCatalogTests
classes.description: A set of unit tests for the DeviceModelCatalog module, checking its behavior with various device attributes.

methods.name: `symbol prefers model identifier prefixes`
methods.description: Tests that the symbol function prioritizes model identifier prefixes for device identification.

methods.name: `symbol uses friendly name for mac variants`
methods.description: Verifies that the symbol function correctly uses the provided friendly name for Mac devices.

methods.name: `symbol falls back to device family`
methods.description: Ensures that the symbol function defaults to device family when other identifiers are unavailable.

methods.name: `presentation uses bundled model mappings`
methods.description: Checks that the presentation function returns the correct title based on device attributes.
